verdict.rationale: Evidence repeatedly asserts uv is 'extremely fast' and community members corroborate the subjective feeling of speed, but no published benchmark suite, methodology, or measured throughput/timing numbers (e.g., comparison charts vs pip/poetry) appear anywhere in the pack. The closest is a third-party mention of informal internal benchmarking (uv-comm-19) with no numbers cited, which does not constitute published benchmark data backing the speed claims.
